description: Retry publishing a failed or partially failed post. Only retries the platforms that failed, not the ones that already succeeded. Platforms in status 'unconfirmed' (the publish request may have reached the platform but its response was lost — the post may already be live) are NOT retried unless republish is true; if the post has unconfirmed platforms and no failed ones, the call fails with a 400 and code UNCONFIRMED_REQUIRES_REPUBLISH — ask the user to check the account on the platform, and only pass republish: true after they confirm the post is not live. Use this when a post failed on some platforms and the user wants to retry just those.

republish.description: Explicit opt-in to also retry platforms in status 'unconfirmed'. Their publish may have already gone through, so this can DUPLICATE the post — only pass true after the user has checked the account and confirmed the post is not live. Defaults to false.

name: retry_post

approver.description: Who approved it: { id, name, image }. Null unless approvalStatus is approved.

assignee.description: Who is expected to act on it next: { id, name, image }. Null when nobody is.

author.description: Who wrote the post: { id, name, image }. Null when that account is gone.

skippedMaxRetries.description: Destinations skipped for hitting the retry ceiling.

status.description: draft, scheduled, processing, published, partial or failed.

title: Retry failed post
